subject: Signal and System
questionText:
A signal x(t) = 2 cos (400𝜋𝜋t) + 6 cos(640𝜋𝜋t) is ideally 
sampled with a sampling frequency fs = 500 Hz. If the 
sampled signal is passed through an LPF with unity 
gain and cut-off frequency of 400 Hz, then frequency 
components appeared at the output is 
 
(a) 200 Hz, 320 Hz 
 
(b) 60 Hz, 80 Hz, 180 Hz, 200 Hz 
 
(c) 180 Hz, 200 Hz, 300 Hz, 320 Hz 
 
(d) 90 Hz, 150 Hz, 160 Hz 𝜋
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-28 (Sampling and It’s Type).
